_comment: Tier-2 for dune::poisson (UFL cell is not the grid cell). dune/ufl/__init__.py::_cell maps dimension straight onto ufl.triangle / ufl.tetrahedron, so a space built on a YaspGrid of quadrilaterals still reports '<Lagrange1 on a triangle>'. A model transferring dolfinx habits reads mesh.ufl_cell() to pick an element family or quadrature degree and gets a lie, quietly. Fixture asserts the grid really is cubes (per-element geometry types + 16 cells in 2D), that the space nevertheless reports simplices, and that aluConformGrid on the SAME cartesianDomain produces triangles with exactly twice the element count. It deliberately does NOT use dof counts to tell cube from simplex: continuous Lagrange order 1 has 25 dofs on both grids because they share the 25 vertices (b5 measured 'CUBE k=1 n=4 dofs=25' and 'SIMPLEX k=1 n=4 dofs=25'); space.size is only cross-checked against the vertex count. Verified by execution against dune-fem 2.12.0.2 on 2026-08-03: structuredGrid 4x4 -> 16 'quadrilateral', space.cell()='triangle', space.size=25; aluConformGrid -> 32 'triangle'. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 builds the 2D grid under test with aluConformGrid on the same cartesianDomain, so the reported UFL cell 'triangle' is true rather than a lie. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations "grid2d_element_types=['quadrilateral']", 'dune_ufl_cell_is_always_simplex=True' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness). ENVIRONMENT: there is no ofa-dune conda env on this host, which is the interpreter scripts/run_tier2_fixtures.py falls back to; dune-fem 2.12.0.2 lives in ~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env. Without DUNE_PYTHON set to that interpreter the runner records this fixture as `skipped`, not `failed`, so a summary that counts only passes and failures shows nothing wrong while nothing was executed. Every measurement quoted above, and the mutation verdict, was taken with DUNE_PYTHON=~/miniconda3/envs/dune-fem-env/bin/python.
